text: Maruba Restaurant and Maruba Inn is a true gem in TukTuk. We enjoyed delicious food at the restaurant, served by humble and kind staff who made us feel very welcome. The views from the property are absolutely beautiful — the perfect setting to relax and unwind. We stayed at the inn and loved the cozy rooms, each with easy access to the lake. Waking up to the peaceful water and natural surroundings was a highlight of our trip. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, warm hospitality, and a relaxing place to stay by the lake.
